figurative_meaning_en: To receive a favor or benefit
similar_in_english: To owe someone a debt of gratitude
example_sentences_in_bangla: তিনি আমার অনেক নুন খেয়েছেন, তাই এখন আমাকে সাহায্য করবেন।
এই সাহায্যের জন্য আমি তার নুন খেয়েছি।
example_sentences_in_english: He has eaten a lot of my salt, so he will help me now.
I have eaten his salt for this help.
note: This idiom reflects the cultural norm of hospitality in Bengali society, where sharing salt symbolizes accepting someone's kindness and incurring a sense of obligation.
